## Breaking change
<!--

On March 19th, 2024 La Marzocco has release the machine firmware update v3.5-rc5 together with a new version of the La Marzocco Home App. 
Once the app update is installed and the previous scheduling functionality is removed from the app and a new scheduling mode is shown, which is disabled until the machine's firmware has also been updated. Similarly, if the machine's firmware is updated before the app, the previous scheduling functionality does not work.

The previous calendar and auto on/off switches are replaced with calendars and switches per schedule.

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
Migrate La Marzocco to lmcloud version 1.1.
The migration from 0.X to 1.X is breaking, that's why the PR changes lots of things. lmcloud 1.0.0 introduced `coffee grinder` support, this PR prepares support, but that will be added in a later PR.

Additionally La Marzocco pushed a Firmware update yesterday, which when installed, breaks to integration. Addionally, they deprecated the schedule in the app and replaced that with a new feature. The new feature is forced on you, but disabled in the app until you do the firmware update.
That's why calendar and auto on/off switches are moved to multiple calendars and auto on/off switches (one per calendar).

Ideally for 2024.6.0

Full changelog for lmcloud: https://github.com/zweckj/lmcloud/compare/v0.4.35...v1.1.11

issue_context.title: New gateway version (v3.4-RC5) and LM app changes scheduling options
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I just updated the gateway version of my LM GS/3 AV to v3.4-RC5 and I'm getting a stream of these errors in my log:

```
2024-03-19 14:57:59.318 ERROR (MainThread) [custom_components.lamarzocco.coordinator] Unexpected error fetching lamarzocco data: 'weeklySchedulingConfig'
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/update_coordinator.py", line 318, in _async_refresh
    self.data = await self._async_update_data()
                ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/config/custom_components/lamarzocco/coordinator.py", line 107, in _async_update_data
    await self._async_handle_request(self.device.get_config)
  File "/config/custom_components/lamarzocco/coordinator.py", line 129, in _async_handle_request
    await func()
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/lmcloud/lm_device.py", line 119, in get_config
    self.parse_config(raw_config)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/lmcloud/lm_machine.py", line 137, in parse_config
    raw_config["weeklySchedulingConfig"]
    ~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
KeyError: 'weeklySchedulingConfig'
2024-03-19 14:59:19.833 WARNING (MainThread) [py.warnings] /usr/local/lib/python3.12/asyncio/unix_events.py:110: RuntimeWarning: coroutine 'WebSocketCommonProtocol.close' was never awaited
  self._signal_handlers[sig] = handle
```

The La Marzocco mobile app was also updated to support (in part) more scheduling options (they say 25 lots, vs. one per day), so I suspect that's part of the problem.  I've been seeing the last line for a while sporadically in the logs, unrelated to this latest issue, but it seems related to this integration.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2024.3.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

La Marzocco

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/lamarzocco/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

I'm currently using the custom "advance" version of the integration that should mirror the next core release, but I also see the same issue with the current core release.
